description: Node.js lets JavaScript run outside a web page. You can use it to work with files, make small tools or build a web server. Start with names, numbers and short functions. Later, learn how files, requests and tests work. This site only shows the Node.js code; use the setup lesson to run it on your computer.
versionNote: Written for Node.js 24 LTS (ES modules, node:test, node:sqlite, built-in fetch) and Express 5. Everything shown also runs on newer Node releases.
whatYouWillLearn: Run a small JavaScript file with Node.js
Read files and send simple web replies
Check that a small program works
learningObjectives: Print text and add two numbers
Call a function with your own value

seo.title: Node.js Tutorial: Learn with Small Steps
seo.description: Learn Node.js step by step: run JavaScript, use files and modules, handle waiting and make a small web server. Includes examples and practice.
